summary.headline: Opposition Horoscope Tables
summary.text: Astrological tabulation for the horoscope of an opposition on Friday, 19 Ramadan, including lunar phases, planetary positions, mansions, and ratios. The accompanying judgment attributes headache, eye pain, dry air, heart defects, and hail to Saturn’s sextile separation and the jurisdictions of Seh and Asad.
